name: cloudkitchen-ai
description: CloudChef — Intelligent Cloud Kitchen Optimization Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,AI" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir ai-service --reload --port 8000"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,AI" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir ai-service --reload --port 8000"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && pip install -r ai-service/requirements.txt
